teaser.en: Digo has two names for the watermelon, and one of them, *renje-madzi*, seems to carry the word for water inside it.
teaser.sw: Kidigo kina majina mawili ya tikiti, na moja wapo, *renje-madzi*, linaonekana kubeba ndani yake neno la maji.
teaser.dg: Chidigo china madzina mairi ga *tigiti*, na rimwenga kahi yao, *renje-madzi*, rinaonekana kukala na neno *madzi* ndani.

summary.en: *Tigiti* is the watermelon, a trailing vine grown on sandy coastal farms. Its big, juicy fruit is a welcome sight in the heat.
summary.sw: *Tigiti* ni tikiti, mmea unaotambaa ardhini unaolimwa katika mashamba ya mchanga ya pwani. Tunda lake kubwa lenye maji mengi hufurahisha sana wakati wa joto.
summary.dg: *Tigiti* (kpwa Chingereza *watermelon*) ni mmea unaoambala photsi, unaorimwa minda ya mtsanga ya pwani. Tundare dzikulu renye madzi manji ni dzambo ra kufurahisha wakati wa dzoho.

about.en: Watermelon is a trailing vine that sprawls across the ground on long, hairy stems, with deeply lobed leaves and small yellow flowers. The fruits are large and round to oval, with a hard green rind that is often striped or mottled. Inside, the flesh is sweet and watery, usually red, and dotted with flat seeds.
about.sw: Tikiti ni mmea unaotambaa na kutanda ardhini kwa mashina marefu yenye vinyweleo, wenye majani yaliyokatika kwa ndani na maua madogo ya manjano. Matunda ni makubwa, ya mviringo hadi umbo la yai, yenye ganda gumu la kijani ambalo mara nyingi lina mistari au madoadoa. Ndani, nyama ni tamu na yenye maji mengi, kwa kawaida nyekundu, na imetawanyika mbegu bapa.
about.dg: *Tigiti* ni mmea unaoambala na kuenea photsi kpwa milita mirefu yenye nyere. Makodzage gana mala marefu, na maruwage ni madide ga rangi ya mandano. Matundage ni makulu, ga mviringo au ganayohalana na tumbi kpwa sura, na gana gada ra chijani renye ufu, ambaro kpwa kawaida ni ra mistari-mistari au ra mabara-mabara. Nyama za ndani ni za mtswano na za madzi manji, kpwa kawaida ni za kundu, na zina tembe sambamba.

where.en: It is grown on sandy farms, where the vines can spread out over the open ground.
where.sw: Hulimwa katika mashamba ya mchanga, ambapo mashina yanaweza kutanda juu ya ardhi wazi.
where.dg: Nkurimwa minda ya mtsanga, ambapho mmea unaweza kuenea photsi phatu phenye nafwasi.

names.en: Digo has two names for the watermelon: *tigiti* and *renje-madzi*. Swahili calls it *tikiti*. In English it is watermelon.
names.sw: Kidigo kina majina mawili ya tikiti: *tigiti* na *renje-madzi*. Kwa Kiswahili linaitwa *tikiti*. Kwa Kiingereza linaitwa *watermelon*.
names.dg: Chidigo china madzina mairi ga tigiti: *tigiti* na *renje-madzi*. Chiswahili chinariiha *tikiti*. Kpwa Chingereza rinaihwa *watermelon*.

reason.en: Another juicy fruit of coastal farms
reason.sw: Tunda lingine lenye maji mengi la mashamba ya pwani
reason.dg: Tunda ranjina renye madzi manji ra minda ya pwani.

sources: Mwalonya, Nicolle, Nicolle & Zimbu, Mgombato: Digo-English-Swahili Dictionary (BTL / Digo Language and Literacy Project, 2004; e-version 2005)
